notes.title: Announcement Regarding Last Light Demo Update
notes.content:
Last Light demo has been updated along with the main game.

[b]<Additional Language in Full Audio>[/b]
- Full Korean audio has been added.

Click here to download the demo.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675620/Last_Light/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675620/Last_Light/[/url]

The update does not affect the area you can explore in the demo.
This demo includes the tutorial and parts of the first floor of the hospital.

[b]<Controls>[/b]
- Tip No.1 [Place Items]
Utilize candles and salt. They WILL save you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996146/4382accce73fcd4368b08afba59aa4a0b1b6b81f.gif[/img]

- Tip No.2 [Hide]
Demons cannot hurt you while you are in the locker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996146/99d973c6c2793feb6076a2a5f27a00d9f0c9f7cf.gif[/img]

- Tip No.3 [Run]
Running is always good to avoid demons, but don’t forget that you use stamina to run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996146/b2a00088815d19dc6c1f03bcf728ced66589a127.gif[/img]

In the main game, you will be encountering even more unique demons and patients through the tense and thrilling quests!

[h5]If you are still uncertain, please consider adding this game to your wishlist![/h5]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675620/Last_Light/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675620/Last_Light/[/url]

notes.title: Update September 14
notes.content:
v.1.0.1.0

[h3][b]<Difficulty Setting Added>[/b][/h3]
-Added a way to choose difficulties from LIGHT, DIM, to DARK.
　You must complete LIGHT to be able to choose DIM.
　You must complete DIM to be able to choose DARK.

[h3][b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b][/h3]
-The time necessary for some ghosts to lose sight of you has decreased.
-The time it takes for ghosts to open doors has increased
　so that players can run away from them by closing doors.
-The number of lockers in each map has increased.
-Some lockers have become more noticeable.
-The location of some objects have been changed for easier movement.
-The number of ghosts has decreased in certain difficulties and floors.

[h3][b]<Improvements>[/b][/h3]
-CHECKING objects has become possible even after being hurt.
　However, the time it takes to CHECK objects has increased.
-An effect has been added for shelves in which keys can be found.
-The corridor on the 3rd floor has been widened and passages on the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd floors have been rearranged.
-The number of keys obtainable has matched the number of locked doors.
-The location of some diaries has been changed.
-Some designs on the maps have been changed.
